commands.name: /torusguard init
commands.description: Initialize TorusGuard in the workspace: detect project stack, activate tailored TG-* rules, and verify SECURITY.md.

commands.name: /torusguard authorize
commands.description: Capture target ownership, allowed hosts, permitted endpoints, and write scope.json for runtime validation.

commands.name: /torusguard audit
commands.description: Execute static AST code audit against active rules, assign Stable Fingerprints, cluster findings, and score confidence.

commands.name: /torusguard verify
commands.description: Validate evidence sufficiency, audit AST source matches, and compute 0–100 confidence score.

commands.name: /torusguard web-validate
commands.description: Dispatch authorized HTTP and API runtime probes with token redaction to test practical reachability.

commands.name: /torusguard exploit-check
commands.description: Execute bounded, safe exploitability confirmation for approved vulnerability classes (SQLi, SSRF, XSS, auth bypass).

commands.name: /torusguard harden
commands.description: Generate structured remediation bundles with framework-native before/after diffs enriched by runtime findings.

commands.name: /torusguard apply
commands.description: Apply surgical, governed patches with strict line addition (<=35) and deletion (<=25) boundaries.

commands.name: /torusguard recheck
commands.description: Re-scan modified files to verify fix integrity and detect potential regressions.

commands.name: /torusguard report
commands.description: Generate unified Markdown executive report, finding cards, and multi-analysis OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 output.

commands.name: /torusguard status
commands.description: Display current security posture, active run history, configuration, and activated rule count.
